channel.title: The Dive Bell
channel.description: Rings, take-backs, the week ahead and the record, from a bell that texts divers only when the water is perfect.

item.title: The bell takes back its word
item.description: The bell takes back its word at Palos Verdes: Tuesday's perfect morning didn't hold - all clear filled in. The bell only rings when it's sure. thedivebell.com/palos-verdes/
